chunks: Who insist on being given full when they take from others,
ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic description of believers' honesty in trade and measurement?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the integrity of the faithful in commercial dealings, specifically noting that they demand full measure when receiving from others, contrasting with their tendency to give short measure when selling. In Shia exegesis, this is often interpreted as a reflection of human nature's tendency toward self-interest, which believers overcome through piety, or as a specific reference to the Prophet and Imams who were perfectly just in all transactions. It serves as a moral benchmark for economic justice, ensuring that the community maintains trust and fairness in market interactions.
